fact: Law no. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 bars any legal decision or decision with legal effects being based solely on automated processing or profiling (art. 27) and creates the IPDCP, an independent authority with sanction powers (arts. 55, 70-72).
title: Loi n° 2019-014 du 29 octobre 2019 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel
publisher: Journal Officiel de la République Togolaise
